title: Sentinel Shield profile manifest
description: The published JSON-Schema face of the profile manifest contract. The RUNTIME authority is scripts/lib/profile-schema.sh, which every consumer (resolver, installer, sync, upgrade, migrate, bootstrap, release packaging, repository audit) runs before reading any manifest field; tests/prod/300-profile-manifest-schema.sh asserts the two agree on every enum, allowlist, pattern and supported version. This document describes role=install (the full surface, including the files a profile installs/syncs). role=policy is the same contract minus the 'files' requirement, for manifests that only participate in tool-policy composition.

$schema.description: Must reference this schema (basename profile.manifest.schema.json). A manifest claiming a different schema is rejected rather than validated against the wrong contract.

profile.description: The profile identifier. Becomes a filesystem path and a shell-set member, so it must be a safe identifier.

never_touch.description: Project-local paths the installer/sync MUST never create or overwrite (e.g. accepted-risks.json, phpstan-baseline.neon).

required_scripts.description: Upstream Sentinel Shield scripts the installed workflow calls (informational; they live in Sentinel Shield, not copied).

recommended_pr_fast_tools.description: Informational: tool keys the profile expects at the PR/fast-feedback stage.

recommended_main_gate_tools.description: Informational: tool keys the profile expects at the main/protected-branch gate.

recommended_scheduled_tools.description: Informational: tool keys the profile expects on scheduled/nightly scans.

tool_notes.description: Free-text maintainer notes keyed by tool identifier. Informational only; never consulted for a policy decision.

tool_policy_version.description: Supported tool-policy schema version. Only 2 is supported in this rollout; other values fail validation with migration guidance. REQUIRED whenever the manifest declares 'tools' or 'extends' — a manifest that participates in tool-policy resolution must state the version it was written against.

extends.description: Base profile names whose tool policies this profile composes (resolved by the canonical resolver). Each name becomes a filesystem path, so it must be a safe identifier; duplicates and self-reference are rejected.

tools.description: Per-tool policy declarations (key = TOOL_TABLE key). See schemas/tool-policy.schema.json and docs/profile-tool-policy.md.

allOf.$comment: A manifest that declares tools or extends participates in tool-policy resolution and must declare the version it was written against.

identifier.description: A safe identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens) — no whitespace, glob characters, path separators, traversal or leading dash.

safeRelativePath.description: A relative path with no whitespace, glob characters, control characters, leading dash, '.' or '..' segment. These values reach shell path probes and unquoted loops.

source.description: Path relative to the Sentinel Shield repo root.

target.description: Path relative to the consuming project root.

mode.description: create-if-missing: write only if absent (project owns it after). merge-required-lines: project-owned, but every non-comment line of the source is REQUIRED — an existing file keeps its own entries and the missing required lines are appended (idempotent). overwrite-if-force: managed; create if absent, overwrite only with --force. sync-managed-block: managed marker block updated in place (reserved). manual: never auto-written; printed for the maintainer to handle.
